definition: ercot52 ORDC cap-dual adder fix (KEEPER-TRACK CANDIDATE, NOT-YET/unattested; single delta on the ercot51 coal-net-summer-derate config = ercot_ordc_cap_dual_adder): the post-solve additive RTORPA sourced the total-family balance dual, which is already folded into the energy LMP whenever the PHYSICAL shared headroom (not the RTOLCAP cap row) is the binding reserve constraint -- every 2023 scarcity hour once the coal derate is on (solved cap-row dual = 0 in all 8760 h), so each shortage hour was priced twice. The fix sources the adder from the supply-cap rows' own duals, the exactly-uninternalized component by LP duality (lambda_balance = lambda_cap + mu_headroom; only mu passes into the energy dual). No new parameter, no price fit; dispatch/energy duals byte-identical to ercot51; offer-curve bands UNCHANGED from the ercot46 keeper.
